name: Country Garden Holdings Company Limited
summary: Country Garden Holdings Company Limited, an investment holding company, invests, develops, and constructs real estate properties in Mainland China. The company develops residential projects, such as townhouses and condominiums, and car parks and retail shops spaces. It also develops, operates, and manages hotels. In addition, the company engages in the robotics and light-asset entrusted management and construction services; rendering of property related sales services; interior decoration activities; and provision of project management and related services, as well as investment consulting services.
